description: Request deletion of unused uploads and compositions in one private scope at the buyer’s request. Returns acceptance and deletion state; it does not cancel an order. Purchased content remains until 90 days after mailing or final cancellation/refund, longer while an order, dispute or legal hold is unresolved.

order_access_token.description: Exact private order_access_token returned by open_private_content for this scope. Keep it private and never invent one.

scope_id.description: Exact scope_id from open_private_content whose unused content the buyer wants deleted.

name: delete_private_content
title: Delete private uploads
